t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The yellow, green and blue gnomes correspond to the yellow basket and the orange, pink and red gnomes correspond to the red basket. Choose a basket initially and then stick with it. When choosing a basket colour, then choose the gnomes that come up which are the colours that correspond to the basket. Change the colour of gnomes to the other one only once the number of mushrooms begins lacking, that's when you know to change.

vb_textbox.text: There are 2 colour baskets that will come up throughout the game; red and yellow. To bring up the red basket, select the red, orange, brown, pink and purple gnomes (the warmer colour scheme). To bring up the yellow basket, select the yellow, green and blue gnomes (a cooler colour scheme). Consistently choose the same colour basket by selecting the corresponding gnomes. Once the number of mushrooms significantly reduces in number, start choosing the coloured gnomes which bring up the other basket colour. So for example, if the gnomes which bring up the yellow basket have very few mushrooms inside, start choosing the gnomes which correspond to the red basket; pink, orange, brown, red, orange, brown e.t.c.
